scenarios.name: German vocabulary preserves case-sensitive topic nouns
scenarios.given: installed German Apple word vectors and the unchanged historical travel passage
scenarios.when: German passage and topic-query vectors are prepared for local History search
scenarios.then: the passage equals the normalized mean of five actual in-vocabulary topic nouns and Flughafen/Reisepass queries carry that Apple model

scenarios.name: German topic minimum and filler refusal remain intact
scenarios.given: installed German lexical tagging and word vectors
scenarios.when: History embeds two topic nouns or the unchanged small-talk controls
scenarios.then: insufficient topic content yields no vector without lowering the existing three-word passage minimum

scenarios.name: Earlier empty derived caches rebuild without changing saved conversations
scenarios.given: an unchanged saved German conversation has an empty derived index under the earlier noun recipe
scenarios.when: the current Apple embedder opens and synchronizes the index
scenarios.then: the stale entry is invalidated and rebuilt with a real German Apple vector while saved conversation bytes and metadata remain unchanged

scenarios.name: English normalization remains compatible
scenarios.given: installed English word vectors and differently cased spellings of the same topic word
scenarios.when: the existing English embedding route is queried
scenarios.then: both spellings retain the existing normalized lowercase word vector

scenarios.name: Non-English queries retain lowercase vocabulary fallback
scenarios.given: the installed Spanish model recognizes pasaporte but not PASAPORTE
scenarios.when: an uppercase topic query is prepared for local History search
scenarios.then: it retains the existing lowercase topic vector when the original spelling is outside the vocabulary
